title: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei calls for slower AI progress, warns of 'catastrophic' risks
description: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei advocates for a more measured pace in artificial intelligence development. He warns that rapid progress could outpace our understanding and control of advanced systems. Amodei proposes a three-step framework to manage frontier AI development responsibly. This includes embedded safety evaluators and international coordination on standards.
